findings.rationale: Accepted: checkout-index would run a configured smudge driver before the integrity pass (reproduced with a sentinel touch driver). §1.1 now drops every .gitattributes from the private index and checks out against an empty --work-tree with core.attributesFile=/dev/null and GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1 (probed 2026-09-17: sentinel never runs, $Id$ literal); the sentinel fixture and a checkout-index control are in §2 (a).

Accepted: core.symlinks=true is forced on the checkout and the integrity pass compares lstat type with the ls-tree mode; the fixture repo sets core.symlinks=false and asserts tree/link is a real symlink (§1.1, §2 (a), acceptance packet-hazards).

Accepted with the fail-closed variant of the repair: path bytes are handled as Buffers and any non-UTF-8 path fails the build closed with `unsupported path encoding: <hex>` before anything is written, so no lossy decode reaches the deny matcher or the manifest; fixture (h4) added. A reversible encoding is unnecessary for the repositories this rail serves.

Accepted: the test asserts exact equality with `git rev-parse --verify` output instead of a 40-hex shape; fixtures use explicit `git init --object-format`; a SHA-256 fixture (h3) proves the manifest and preimage are object-format agnostic (§1.1, §2 (d), (h3)).
